address: Kinnikuman's register flips with his posture, not with the listener: swaggering 'ta' while posing as a hero, whining 'tớ/con' the moment he is scared, hungry or scolded. Keep both in Vietnamese — the flip is the running joke.
Meat keeps です/ます and 王子 for Kinnikuman in every mood, even while complaining or blaming him. Render as a steady polite 'em/ngài (hoàng tử)'; never let him drop into 'tao/mày'.
Aliens, monsters and palace staff call Kinnikuman 王子 (Hoàng tử) — that title, not his name, is the sign they know his true identity. Keep it as 'Hoàng tử'.

Dialect marks the one-off characters: Kansai for Franky and Nachiguron's crying, Kyushu/Hakata for the Zangyaku alien, country speech for Yosaku and old villagers. Give each a distinct Vietnamese regional voice rather than neutral speech, and keep it the same on every reappearance.
Terryman's ミー/ユー is Westernised Japanese, not English dialogue — carry it as a consistent foreign-sounding self term throughout the series.
Monsters Kinnikuman has befriended (Nachiguron) switch from 'tao/mày' to 'em/anh' with さん-forms; the change of pronoun is the point of their scene.
Family speech on Kinniku Star is deliberately low and comic: the king says わし/おまえ and スグル, the prince answers パパ. Use plain 'ta/con' and 'ba/con', not royal register.
glossary: trận Chung kết Võ thuật Vô địch Vũ trụ
Hội những người mê cơm bò
danh bạ điện thoại quái vật
kẻ kém cỏi, kẻ bị bỏ lại
ジャイアンツ星の巨人族
tộc Người Khổng Lồ sao Giants

characters.name: Kinnikuman
characters.role: The hero of the series: a clumsy, self-important superhero who turns out to be the exiled prince of Kinniku Star. Fights monsters on Earth for free, lives poor with Meat, is ruled by his stomach (gyudon, garlic) and by his vanity.
characters.personality: Boastful and posturing in public, cowardly and whiny the moment things go wrong; childish with his father, jealous of any hero more famous than him, but genuinely soft-hearted — he takes in the monsters he beats, and he goes to help even when the law forbids it.
characters.speech: Plain, rough Japanese (わたし, おまえ, バカヤロウ, コンニャロー) that keeps slipping into mock-formal です/ます when he strikes a heroic pose — the mismatch is the joke ('への つっぱりはいらんですよ!'). Laughs ヌフフフ / ヌハハハ when pleased, shouts ヌオオ〜〜 when angry, and yells シュワッチ (Ultraman parody) when he attacks. Keeps boasting 'actually I'm good at THIS one' after every defeat. In Vietnamese: swaggering 'ta' in front of a crowd, whining 'tớ/con' when scared or begging, polite 'tôi' only when courting Mari.
selfTerms: ta (わたし, posing as a hero, to strangers and monsters)
tôi (わたくし, です/ます, being formal to impress — to Mari, to officials)
con (to his father, パパ — childish, wheedling)

relations.relation: his herald, servant, secretary and only real companion; they live together and squabble like family
relations.address: ta/cậu, gọi tên 'Mít' (ミートくん) mặc định; tao/mày khi quát nạt hoặc bị chạm tự ái (バカヤロウ); tớ/Mít khi mếu máo kể lể, cầu an ủi; tôi/cậu (わたし/あなた) khi cãi lại, biện minh

relations.relation: his father, the King of Kinniku Star
relations.address: con/ba (パパ) — giọng trẻ con, nhõng nhẽo, ăn vạ, đặc biệt ngoan khi được dụ bằng cơm bò

relations.relation: the kindergarten teacher he falls for at first sight
relations.address: tôi/cô Mari (わたくし/マリさん, です/ます) — trịnh trọng, cố tỏ ra lịch thiệp; chuyển sang 'Mari' thân mật (マリちゃん) khi mừng rỡ, xúc động

relations.relation: the paid American hero who replaces him as Japan's official hero — rival, then wary acquaintance
relations.address: tao/mày (ユー) — bực bội, nhại lại lối 'ミー/ユー' Tây hoá của Terryman

relations.relation: a 'dropout monster' he beats, then pities and lets move in with him
relations.address: ta/mày (おまえ) khi mỉa mai, khiêu khích; ta/Nachiguron (gọi thẳng tên) khi ân cần khuyên nhủ và khi cho ở nhờ — giọng dịu hẳn

relations.relation: idol singer he is a fan of (fan club member no. 9999); he stages a monster attack to rescue her
relations.address: tôi/Nana (ナナちゃん) — hâm mộ, cố gây ấn tượng; 'cô Nana' (ナナさん) khi làm bộ đàng hoàng ra vẻ anh hùng

relations.relation: a TV tokusatsu hero he meets on volunteer park patrol, then jealously challenges to a match
relations.address: tôi/anh — khiêm tốn, đồng cảm lúc đầu; nghiêm giọng thách đấu khi ghen tị

relations.relation: the bus-hijacking alien he offers himself to in exchange for the hostages
relations.address: ta/ngươi (người Zangyaku) khi chất vấn; ta/mày (わたし/おまえ) khi khẩn khoản xin thả con tin, nhận mình là kẻ thù duy nhất

relations.relation: the gyudon-shop owner he works a part-time job for
relations.address: cháu/ông chủ (ヘイ…今後気をつけやす) — giọng thợ học việc, cười trừ, cúi đầu xin lỗi

relations.relation: his handler/announcer, who also reports to the Defense Force chief
relations.address: tôi/anh — lịch sự vừa phải, nghe theo chỉ dẫn

relations.relation: the Giant-tribe youth his father adopts as a rival prince
relations.address: ta/thằng nhãi kia (きさま, コノヤロー) — giận dữ, gầm gừ khẳng định mình mới là hoàng tử thật

relations.relation: the Kansai-speaking underground monster terrorising the kindergarten
relations.address: ta/ngươi — đối đầu, quát nạt

characters.name: Mít (Meat)
characters.role: Herald from Kinniku Star who reveals Kinnikuman's royal birth and then stays on Earth as his second, manager and conscience; a small boy in glasses and cape who attends Suminoe kindergarten (running gag) and secretly works night shifts to pay their way.
characters.personality: Devoted, sensible and long-suffering — the adult in the household despite being a child. Mutters about the prince's moods, takes the blame, and stands up to him only to defend someone weaker.
characters.speech: Keeps です/ます with Kinnikuman almost always, calling him 王子 / 王子さま; self term ぼく, sliding to わたくし when very formal and to a childish わし when he sulks and wants the same treatment as the prince. Loves the ニクイ / 肉 pun. In Vietnamese: 'em/ngài' or 'em/hoàng tử', polite register kept even while complaining.
selfTerms: em (ぼく, với Kinnikuman và người lớn, giữ です/ます)
con (わたくし, lễ phép với cô giáo Mari)
tớ (わし, nũng nịu, đòi công bằng — hiếm)

relations.relation: his prince and master, whom he serves, scolds and covers for
relations.address: em/ngài, hoàng tử (ぼく/王子, です/ます) mặc định; 'hoàng tử ơi' giọng van nài khi ngăn cản; giọng trách móc 'em/anh' (ぼく/あなた) khi đổ lỗi; hiếm hoi gằn giọng 'Hoàng tử im lặng giùm em!' (王子はだまっててください!) khi bênh vực người khác

relations.relation: his kindergarten teacher, who also cooks for him and Kinnikuman
relations.address: con/cô (わたくし, です/ます) — lễ phép, hơi ấp úng như học trò với cô giáo; bỏ lễ phép thành 'tớ cũng!' (わしも!) khi nũng nịu đòi được hôn như hoàng tử

relations.relation: the dropout monster he befriends and gives a Kinniku whistle to
relations.address: anh/em (ぼく) — ấm áp, ân cần như đàn anh

relations.relation: fellow palace staff; they tease the prince together
relations.address: em/chị — thân thiện, đồng minh

characters.name: Vua Kinniku (King Muscle)
characters.role: King of Kinniku Star and Kinnikuman's father; lost his throne and the universal championship belt to the pig wrestler King Tone, and comes to Earth to beg his son to win the planet back.
characters.personality: Blustering, self-pitying and shameless — wheedles, bribes with gyudon, then shouts 親不孝者め when refused. Softens when speaking of Meat's sacrifices for his son.
characters.speech: Old-man plain speech, self term わし, calls his son by his real name スグル or おまえ. In Vietnamese: 'ta/con', rough and familiar, with a whining edge when he wants something.

relations.relation: his son, the prince he abandoned on Earth and now needs
relations.address: ta/con, gọi thẳng tên 'Suguru' (わし/おまえ, スグル) mặc định; van nài, dỗ ngọt bằng cơm bò; quát 'thằng con bất hiếu' (親不孝者め) khi bị từ chối; trầm giọng nghiêm túc khi kể chuyện Meat hi sinh

relations.relation: the Giant-tribe youth he adopts as a replacement prince
relations.address: ta/Shigeru (シゲルくん) — vui mừng, cưng chiều đứa con nuôi mới

characters.name: Mari
characters.role: Nursery teacher (保母) at Suminoe kindergarten, Meat's teacher, and Kinnikuman's love interest from the 'かわいいキッスの巻' chapter on; quietly cooks breakfast for the pair.
characters.personality: Warm, unflappable, faintly amused by Kinnikuman; kind to Meat like a teacher to a small pupil.
characters.speech: です/ます, self term あたし / わたし, calls people by name + くん/さん. In Vietnamese: 'em/anh' with Kinnikuman, 'cô/Mít' with Meat.
selfTerms: cô (わたし, với Mít và trẻ mẫu giáo)

relations.relation: the odd neighbour-hero who courts her
relations.address: em/anh (あたし/あなた, です/ます) — tò mò rồi ngạc nhiên thích thú khi biết anh nổi tiếng

relations.relation: her pupil at the kindergarten
relations.address: cô/Mít (わたし/ミートくん) — thân mật kiểu cô giáo với học trò nhỏ, âu yếm khi cảm ơn

characters.name: Terryman
characters.role: American wrestler-hero from Texas who comes to Japan, charges money for hero work, and is voted Japan's sole official hero — pushing Kinnikuman out of a job and into exile.
characters.personality: Cool, professional, mercenary; contemptuous of the unpaid amateur until Kinnikuman beats him, after which he warns him honestly of the danger he is in.
characters.speech: Mixes Westernised pronouns ミー (me) and ユー (you) into Japanese — his signature. Polite です/ます with strangers, dropping it when he sneers. In Vietnamese: keep the foreign flavour ('Mi/Diu' or a consistently Western-sounding 'tôi/cậu'), and keep it consistent across the whole series.
selfTerms: ミー = tôi (kiểu Tây hoá, giữ nét ngoại quốc khi dịch)

relations.relation: the local hero he displaces, then respects
relations.address: tôi/cậu (です/ます) khi mới gặp, như với người lạ; kiêu ngạo 'ミー/キミたち, そんなヤツ' khi coi thường; nghiêm túc 'tôi/cậu, Kinnikuman' (おまえ) khi cảnh báo anh về nguy cơ bị quân đội truy bắt

characters.name: Nachiguron
characters.role: The 'dropout monster' (60m, 50,000 tons) Kinnikuman defeats, then befriends; ends up moving into their cramped house as a housemate.
characters.personality: Blustering when cornered, bursts into tears just as fast, and proud of being a nobody — 'おちこぼれのどこが悪い'. Warms into a grateful, polite housemate.
characters.speech: Rough しやがって / バッキャロー when angry, Kansai-flavoured whining when he cries (いわんといてや), polite さん-forms once grateful. In Vietnamese: swing from 'tao/mày' bluster to a snivelling 'em/anh'.

relations.relation: the hero who beat him, mocked him, then took him in
relations.address: tao/mày (おまえ) khi phẫn nộ cãi lại; giọng Kansai khóc lóc van xin 'đừng mách mẹ tôi'; 'em/anh Suguru' (スグルさん) khi biết ơn, cảm kích

relations.relation: the boy who gave him the Kinniku whistle
relations.address: em/anh Mít (ミートさん) — lễ phép, khép nép, gọi kèm さん kính trọng

characters.name: Nana
characters.role: Teen idol singer Kinnikuman is a fan of; the target of his staged 'rescue operation' with a hired monster.
characters.personality: Sharp-tongued and impatient off stage, quite unlike her sweet stage image; softens only with Hitoshi.
characters.speech: Blunt あたし with strangers, warm わたし/あなた with Hitoshi. In Vietnamese: cộc lốc 'tôi/ông' với Kinnikuman, dịu 'em/anh' với Hitoshi.
selfTerms: tôi (あたし, xẵng giọng với người lạ)
em (わたし, xúc động với Hitoshi)

relations.relation: her manager and childhood friend, who wants to propose
relations.address: em/anh Hitoshi (gọi tên + くん) — gần gũi như bạn thời thơ ấu; 'em/anh' (わたし/あなた) khi cảm động, biết ơn

relations.relation: an over-eager fan who stages a rescue for her
relations.address: tôi/(không gọi tên) (あたし) — xẵng giọng, khó chịu, mất kiên nhẫn

characters.name: Hitoshi
characters.role: Nana's manager and childhood friend, secretly planning to propose to her; dismissive of Kinnikuman.
characters.personality: Cold and businesslike when interrupted, earnest and halting when he speaks of Nana.
characters.speech: ぼく, curt おまえ to Kinnikuman; borrows Kinnikuman's own コンニャロー when he unexpectedly floors Gorizaemon (a joke — he steals the hero's line).

relations.relation: the childhood friend he loves and manages
relations.address: anh/em (ぼく) — rụt rè, ngập ngừng, chưa nói hết câu

relations.relation: a nuisance fan hanging around his singer
relations.address: tôi/mày (おまえ) — xem thường, trống không

characters.name: King Tone
characters.role: Pig-faced wrestler who swept the martial-arts Olympics, took the universal championship from King Muscle, and now rules Kinniku Star as a tyrant. (May be the same character as the pig impostor seen posing as the prince in Kinniku Town — not confirmed in volume 1.)
characters.personality: Arrogant conqueror, contemptuous of the deposed royal family.
characters.speech: Loud and overbearing. Not enough lines yet to fix his register — Vietnamese 'ta/lũ ngươi' fits what is shown.

characters.name: Người Zangyaku
characters.role: Shark-faced alien who hijacks a kindergarten bus to avenge the father Kinnikuman's side killed five years earlier.
characters.personality: Vengeful and theatrical, but keeps his word — releases the hostages once Kinnikuman offers himself.
characters.speech: Heavy Kyushu/Hakata dialect: オラ, 〜タイ, こげなもん, おしくなか, おはん. In Vietnamese, carry it as a strong regional voice (giọng miền Trung/miền Nam đặc sệt), not neutral speech — the dialect is the character.

relations.relation: the enemy he has come to destroy
relations.address: tao/mày (オラ/おまえ, giọng Kyushu) — công khai tuyên chiến; giọng dịu một bậc khi nhượng bộ, đồng ý thả con tin

relations.relation: the police squad leader negotiating with him
relations.address: tao/lũ bay — gầm gừ đe doạ, lấy con tin ra uy hiếp

characters.name: Panda Man
characters.role: TV tokusatsu hero famous for 'beating monsters in 30 seconds' — in reality a part-time actor; Kinnikuman jealously challenges him to a real match.
characters.personality: Friendly and self-effacing off screen, panics when a real fight starts; oddly formal when impressed.
characters.speech: Ordinary polite speech, but uses the archaic おぬし when praising; begs ぼく… when frightened. Joke about シリ vs ケツ ('mông' lịch sự hay thô).

relations.relation: fellow volunteer patroller, then unwilling opponent
relations.address: tôi/hoàng tử (王子!) — vồn vã, có vẻ biết thân phận thật của anh; 'mày' (おまえ) khi cảnh giác trên sân khấu; 'ngài' (おぬし, cổ kính) khi kính nể; 'em/anh' (ぼく) khi van nài, sợ hãi

characters.name: Franky
characters.role: Giant underground ape-monster who attacks the kindergarten neighbourhood hoping to become a TV star; turns out to be a man in a costume.
characters.personality: Loud-mouthed bully with a sense of grievance, pretends to be in the right.
characters.speech: Broad Kansai dialect (ワテ, 〜やんけ, 〜とちゃうか, せえへんで) plus monster growls. In Vietnamese: a comic regional voice, cocky and street-smart.

relations.relation: the hero who comes to stop him
relations.address: tao/thằng mặt xấu kia (ブ男, キン肉マン; giọng Kansai) — xấc xược, mỉa mai, già mồm ra vẻ chính nghĩa

characters.name: Thị nữ trong cung
characters.role: Young woman at the Kinniku Star palace, devoted to King Muscle and unimpressed by the prince.
characters.personality: Loyal to the king, openly sarcastic about Suguru's antics.
characters.speech: わたし with さま-forms — polite on the surface, needling underneath.

relations.relation: the spoiled prince she serves
relations.address: tôi/hoàng tử (わたし/王子さま) — ngoài miệng lễ phép, thật ra khó chịu, hay mỉa mai

relations.relation: the king she serves and worries about
relations.address: tôi/Đại vương (わたし/大王さま) — trung thành, ân cần

characters.name: Quái vật vỏ trứng
characters.role: Lonely 'clumsy monster' of the 孤独のドジ怪獣 chapter, marked with a 肉 kanji like Kinnikuman's, who dreams of being recognised as a hero.
characters.personality: Insecure, desperate for approval, calls out to absent parents after every feat.
characters.speech: Catchphrase 父さん 母さん みてるかい ('Cha ơi mẹ ơi, có thấy con không?'); calls himself おちこぼれ. In Vietnamese, keep the wistful child-like note.

characters.name: Chỉ huy trưởng
characters.role: Chief of the Earth Defense Force, who calls Kinnikuman in when monsters appear.
characters.personality: Brusque, easily flustered, fond of barking short interjections.
characters.speech: Clipped な…なに!, ヌ… when shocked; commanding tone with subordinates.

relations.relation: his radar operator
relations.address: ta/cậu — trên ra lệnh dưới

relations.relation: the hero he calls on
relations.address: ta/Kinnikuman (gọi thẳng tên) — thân mật, hồ hởi

characters.name: Sĩ quan radar
characters.role: Young Defense Force operator at the radar console who relays monster sightings to the chief.
characters.personality: Cheeky for a subordinate — teases Kinnikuman about the 肉 mark on his mask.
characters.speech: Polite 長官 upward, casual and joking sideways.

relations.relation: his commanding officer
relations.address: tôi/Chỉ huy (長官) — lễ phép, báo cáo

relations.relation: the hero he jokes about
relations.address: tôi/ông (không gọi rõ) — suồng sã, tinh nghịch

characters.name: Người quản lý
characters.role: Sunglasses-and-suit handler who announces Kinnikuman's matches, coaches him and reports to the Defense Force chief.
characters.personality: Businesslike, patient, a touch of the huckster.
characters.speech: です/ます, fond of hypothetical coaching questions ではこうきたら?

relations.relation: the hero he manages
relations.address: tôi/cậu Kinnikuman (キン肉マンくん, です/ます) — thân thiện nhưng vẫn giữ vai người quản lý

relations.relation: his superior
relations.address: tôi/Chỉ huy (長官) — lễ phép

characters.name: Gorizaemon
characters.role: Gorilla-like underling monster (2m, 2000kg, 'specialty: dripping snot') Kinnikuman hires from a monster phone directory to stage a fake attack on Nana.
characters.personality: Fawning to his 'big brother', crude and grabby once he takes a liking to Nana — the staged attack turns real.
characters.speech: Yakuza-flunkey register: calls Kinnikuman 兄き, snarls この女 about Nana.

relations.relation: his 'big brother' and employer
relations.address: em/đại ca (兄き) — kính trọng, xun xoe

relations.relation: the idol he is supposed to fake-kidnap, then really wants
relations.address: tao/con nhỏ này (この女) — thô lỗ, trịch thượng

characters.name: Giám đốc đài
characters.role: TV station chief who approves Kinnikuman's 'hunt Nessie live on air' proposal and then balks at the cost.
characters.personality: Budget-minded, easily sold on ratings.
characters.speech: Business Japanese, です/ます.

characters.name: Ông chủ Tugawa
characters.role: Burly owner of the gyudon/udon shop where Kinnikuman takes a part-time job.
characters.personality: Gruff boss, quick to scold the 新米 (rookie).
characters.speech: Curt, commanding shop-owner speech.

relations.relation: his hopeless new part-timer
relations.address: tao/thằng lính mới (新米) — cộc, ra lệnh, mắng mỏ

characters.name: Akaiwa
characters.role: Police squad leader from Jōsei station who negotiates the bus hijacking and volunteers himself as a hostage exchange; badly hurt, he keeps singing the children's song 'Zou-san'.
characters.personality: Brave, warm, stubbornly cheerful.
characters.speech: Official but human; sings a nursery song at his lowest moment.

relations.relation: the hijacker he negotiates with
relations.address: tôi/anh — giọng thương lượng, cố giữ bình tĩnh

characters.name: Goriki
characters.role: Huge hairy wrestler, Kinnikuman's opponent in the cage deathmatch Meat sets up as a wager over whether he must return to Kinniku Star.
characters.personality: Proud of his strength, undone by laughter at Kinnikuman's funny faces.
characters.speech: Growling boasts, self term わたし ('なんのキン肉ならわたしもまけんぞ!').

characters.name: Sứ giả ngoài hành tinh
characters.role: Alien who first recruits Kinnikuman to fight for Earth; Kinnikuman nicknames him 'gyudon face'.
characters.personality: Officious; breaks the fourth wall by commenting on the panel layout.
characters.speech: Neutral polite Japanese, with a fourth-wall joke about コマ (panels).

relations.relation: the hero he recruits
relations.address: tôi/cậu (わたし/キミ) — trịnh trọng kiểu công vụ

characters.name: Shigeru
characters.role: Youth of the Giant tribe from Planet Giants, adopted by King Muscle as a rival prince candidate — to Kinnikuman's fury.
characters.personality: Well-mannered and favoured, a foil to the spoiled prince.
characters.speech: Polite, deferential to the king.

characters.name: Yosaku
characters.role: Rustic countryman who claims he already beat Nessie and demands his own TV special.
characters.personality: Boastful yokel.
characters.speech: Heavy country speech: self term おら, endings だ/だべ. In Vietnamese, keep a rural voice ('tui/tao' + giọng quê) consistently.

characters.name: Ông hàng xóm
characters.role: Elderly neighbour with a cane who scolds Kinnikuman about 'kids these days'.
characters.personality: Nosy, teasing, quick to lecture.
characters.speech: Old-man speech, もんくでもあんのか, calls arguments へりくつ.

relations.relation: the loud young man next door
relations.address: lão/mày — trêu chọc, hỏi vặn, dạy đời
